Name: Rock Slug
Description:
Small, slimy, and hard to spot.
Don't wear any of your good shirts around it!

Name: Goblin Goon
Description:
A pittiful goon.
Does paltry damage when it isn't groveling.

Name: Spiderling
Description:
A small construct spawned from the Gear-Spider.
 Weak on its own, but attacks in swarms of up to a hundred.

Name: Space Mite
Description:
Tiny bugs that live on asteroids.
Always covered in a thin layer of dust...from the moon.

Ability.Name: Pokin' Stick
Ability.Description:
Wait. This is just a rusty nail!
Has a chance to give you tetanus.

Name: Goblin Big-Boss
Description:
Bigger and tougher than his underlings, this goblin is particuarily cantankerous.
Don't let him poke you!

Ability.Name: Steamgun
Ability.Description:
Fire a concussive blast of steam.
Has a chance of immobilizing a target completely.

Name: Gear-Spider
Description:
A hulking brass beast in the shape of a spider.
Can't spin webs, but does posess a powerful ranged attack.

Ability.Name: Split
Ability.Description: Splits self into two smaller copies.

Name: Giant Ooze
Description: A massive glob of protoplasm, content to devour anything that crosses its path.

AbilityList.Name: Rock Pounder
AbilityList.Description: A mighty slam that can smash through solid rock.

AbilityList.Name: Sky Cutter
AbilityList.Description: A fearsome attak that slices the fabric of reality in two.

Name: Star-beast
Description: A horrible beast that lurks on the threshold of reality.

Name: Angel
Description:
A being from a higher level of existance.
Hostile to all life.

Name: Centipede
Description:
Tiny, biting insects with a horrific number of legs.
Lay their eggs in rotting carcases.

Ability.Name: Pokin' Stick
Ability.Description:
Wait. This is just a rusty nail!
Has a chance to give you tetanus.

Name: Water Strider
Description: A strange looking bug that skirts atop the water like a boat.
